==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{Discord|discordname=|name=|date=|messagelink=|quote=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

<span style="color:red">'''Per [[Forum:CT:Citing Discord messages from Official Discords|this CT]], please start a new Consensus track to use any message that isn't from either Wookieepedia's Discord or an Official Discord as a citation. If the CT passes, the screenshot of said message needs to be added to [[Wookieepedia:Discord screenshots]]!'''</span>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|discordname}} Discord username.
*{{Para|name}} Full name of the Discord user.
*{{Para|messagelink}} Discord URL link to the message.
*{{Para|archivefile}} The uploaded Wookieepedia filename of the screenshot taken of the Discord conversation.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|date}} Date the Discord post was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} Quote of the Discord conversation.

==Example(s)==
